description: Angular component for configuring alarm rule filters in the Thingsboard UI, including form handling, overlay panel toggling, and filter state management.

classes.name: AlarmRuleFilterConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for alarm rule filter configuration with form and overlay panel.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up form and state based on injected data.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the filter configuration and updates form and display.

methods.name: toggleAlarmRuleFilterPanel
methods.description: Opens overlay panel for filter configuration.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels overlay panel and resets form.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Applies changes from form to filter config.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets form to initial filter configuration.

methods.name: alarmRuleFilterConfigEquals
methods.description: Checks equality of two filter configs.

methods.name: updateAlarmRuleConfigForm
methods.description: Updates form with given filter config.

methods.name: alarmRuleConfigUpdated

methods.name: alarmRuleFilterConfigFromFormValue
